कृत् a. [कृ-क्विप्] (Generally at the end
of comp.) Accomplisher, doer, maker,
performer, manufacturer, composer
&c.; पाप˚, पुण्य˚, प्रतिमा˚ &c. --m.
1 A
class of affixes used to form
derivatives (nouns, adjectives &c.) from
roots.
--2 A word so formed.
--Comp.
--अंतः a word ending
with a kṛt affix.
--लोपः the
rejection of kṛt affixes.

कृत् {vI.v} {c6c} P. (कृंतति-कृत्त) To cut, cut
off, divide, tear asunder, cut in pieces,
destroy; प्रहरति विधिर्मर्मच्छेदी न
कृंतति जीवितं

. {vII.v}
{c7c} P. (कृणत्ति, कृत्त)
1 To spin.
--2 To
surround, encompass.
--3 To attire.

mention, repeat, utter: नाम्नि कीर्तित
एव

.
--3 To name, call.
--4 To praise, glorify, commemorate;
अपप्रथत्गुणान् भ्रातुरचिकीर्तच्च विक्रमं
